en.headline: Citywide Halloween cosplay parties take place across five districts today
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s first Halloween Month culminates on Saturday with free cosplay street parties and events in Central, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui East and Kai Tak.
body: Saturday marks the finale of the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s inaugural Halloween Month, with cosplay celebrations scheduled in five districts.

In Central, the Chater Road pedestrian zone hosts a street takeover that includes performances and a Star Wars parade by the 501st Hong Kong Garrison, running into the night. Lan Kwai Fong is holding a Monster Night cosplay carnival with DJs, while Mong Kok has a large outdoor festival outside Langham Place featuring Cantopop and street food. Tsim Sha Tsui East’s Mody Road Garden is staging a Grand Halloween Gala with music, and Kai Tak Sports Park’s Dining Cove offers free trick-or-treat activities, body painting and a market.

The organisers said the events blend local culture with Halloween themes and are open to the public, with free admission at most venues. Details of any ticketed elements in Central are available from the event organisers.

zh.headline: 旅發局萬聖節月壓軸 五區今日舉行Cosplay街頭派對
zh.dek: 香港旅遊發展局首個萬聖節月今日進入高潮，中環、蘭桂坊、旺角、尖沙咀東及啟德五區同日舉辦Cosplay慶祝活動。
body: 星期六是香港旅遊發展局首個萬聖節月的壓軸日，五區安排Cosplay慶祝活動。
中環遮打道行人專區有街頭接管活動，包括表演及501st香港軍團的星球大戰巡遊，活動延至深夜。蘭桂坊舉辦怪物之夜Cosplay嘉年華，現場有DJ；旺角朗豪坊外則有大型戶外嘉年華，設廣東歌及街頭小食。尖沙咀東麼地道公園舉行大型萬聖嘉年華音樂活動，啟德體育園美食海灣則有免費Trick or Treat、身體彩繪及市集。
主辦單位表示，活動融合本地文化與萬聖節元素，大部分場地免費入場。中環部分項目如需購票，詳情可向主辦單位查詢。
